messages.subject: Ancestral Shape Reconstruction via anc.BM
parts:
Hello, 

This is a question regarding the main method for ancestral landmark estimation, when using gm.prcomp with a phylogeny. I'm trying to interpet the code of anc.BM, but I figured it might be faster to ask directly if anc.BM is using PGLS or essentially phylogenetic independent contrasts to estimate landmarks. 

Best, 

Ricardo

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Ancestral Shape Reconstruction via anc.BM
parts:
Hi Ricardo,

The code employs the Ho and Ané (2014) algorithm, which is consistent with using phylogenetic independent contrasts, trait by trait (coordinate by coordinate).

Best, Mike

Tung Ho, L. S., & Ané, C. (2014). A linear-time algorithm for Gaussian and non-Gaussian trait evolution models. Systematic Biology, 63(3), 397-408.
